summary: Future AGI's Startup Program v2.0 gives eligible startups $6,000 in platform credits, described as one year of free credits to build, test, and iterate, plus 6 months of Pro Plan access with every feature unlocked (advanced evals, custom guardrails, priority queues) and direct engineering support. Eligibility: less than $10M in total funding raised, company less than 5 years old, building a product that uses LLMs or AI agents, and a live product or working prototype. No credit card required; applications take about 2 minutes and are reviewed within 48 hours. After the program, accounts move to standard pricing starting at $99/mo.
claim_steps: Open https://futureagi.com/startups/ and check the eligibility criteria
Submit the application (takes about 2 minutes; no credit card required)
Wait for review, which Future AGI says happens within 48 hours

social_proof.title: Startups | Launch with confidence | Future AGI
social_proof.text: $6K in credits. 6 months Pro. Direct engineering support. $6,000 Platform Credits One year of free credits to build, test, and iterate without worrying about cost. No credit card required. We review every application personally.
